lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: This dreadful presence... It isn't the energy of the Order of Deimos that I know. No, it feels as though something else is mixed in...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel it too. There's definitely something inside the meteorite.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: It would take too long to deal with these alien beings and then make our way inside.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: While I cut down the creatures emerging from it, I'd like you to go inside, %s. See for yourself whether it's an ominous presence or a trace of the relic.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you sure I should go?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: My master has recognized your abilities, %s. And you can do things I cannot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does that mean I've earned your recognition too, Ell?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I simply respect people with talent, whatever their field.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Just don't tease me about being afraid of... ghosts and such.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've never teased you. Hehe...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Now, let's hurry. That's enough chatting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll head in, then.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Yes. I'll get moving as well.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: So this is my master's homeland...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: For the master who took in my brother and me, I must finish our work here properly before returning.
(Deep in the Star of the Void, you sense something suspicious.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where am I?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wandered all the way in here, but that thing over there...
(A serpentine being, shrouded in a suspicious aura, stares intently at you.)
Oh? You're from Luminous.
You did well to find me. He must have guided you. In any case, I've been waiting, master of the cards.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, you know me? You're no ordinary snake... A snake that speaks! Could you be Ouroboros?!
So you know his name. Just as I thought... But I am not he.
I'm reminded of what he said to you. That you would be a great hindrance to his work! That he would regret not disposing of you then and there!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ouroboros! Where is Ouroboros now?
Why so impatient? Though I am not he, I am his shadow... You may call me the Serpent's Shadow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll ask you again. Where is Ouroboros?

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: You're tiresome. Let me tell you something other than where he is.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Where shall I begin, and where shall I end? Perhaps with the fact that you are far from the only person with a soul like yours?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A sudden chill runs through you at the Serpent's Shadow's words.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: O-Ouroboros is plotting something.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: You may not understand, but you sense it instinctively, don't you?

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: His will speaks to me. It tells me to devour you. That if he devours you, even the gods of this place will acknowledge him.
(The Serpent's Shadow suddenly licks its lips.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Our meeting here is his will—the thing he calls fate. So I will swallow you whole.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: I will devour anything that stands in his way. That is my purpose.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: And yet, just as a god changed this world's fate, I now wish to do the same. With the power you possess, perhaps even I could break free of his will...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're Ouroboros's shadow, yet you defy him. Do you want to become a god?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, more than that... You seem to know something.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Perhaps I know everything you seek. If you cannot bear the truth, letting yourself be devoured would be the wiser choice. Now, choose.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Your refusal cannot stop the will that is about to be unleashed. I desire it, and so does he.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll make you regret those words. Finding Ouroboros is the way to protect everyone.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: If you can.
(No sooner has it finished speaking than the Serpent's Shadow opens its jaws wide, baring enormous fangs.)

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: G-graaaah...

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Impossible... His will, overcome by a mere human...

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Even if I am only a shadow...
(The Serpent's Shadow slows. Then its form begins to fade.)

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: He no longer permits me to exist...

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: ...So this is how I vanish.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: After all these years spent upholding his will... Simply because a human defeated me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tell me. Where is Ouroboros?

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Even without my answer, your will shall find him. You are no ordinary human.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what am I?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was an ordinary student in Luminous City who came into possession of Mana Cards. Ever since then, I haven't been able to go back.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: That is not quite it...

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: You truly know nothing of yourself. You don't even know the truth of the cards. Hehe... The road to oblivion does suit you.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: The one who rose from human to god knows far too little as well. If you wish to know...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you talking about? Tell me!

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Let the god look upon the place where I disappear, and see the truth she does not know. She will give you the wisest answer.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Ouroboros... How could you leave me like this... Like...
(The Serpent's Shadow disappears completely.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ouroboros, answer me! Where are you?! You're watching me, aren't you?
(An apparition of Iris appears before %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Iris?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s, I'm sorry to appear so suddenly...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The Serpent's Shadow said to look where it disappeared...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It meant over there...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes... Can you see something?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It seems to be something only I can see. Something visible only to my eyes...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Let me take a look, then I'll tell you.
(Iris's apparition gazes intently at the place where the Serpent's Shadow disappeared.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what is this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly, memories of that time surface.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Why am I remembering these things? Is Iris seeing these memories too?)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Who is that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The person Iris is asking about seems to be Nii.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: I am Nii, guardian of Luminous City...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Nii... I can picture Nii clearly. I wonder how things are going.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: The people of Luminous City do not yet know of their existence, but before long, Luminous too will become part of these worlds.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: As long as we remain here to prevent this world's collapse, you alone can pursue Ouroboros.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Odin, I'm sorry... I still haven't found him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I need to gain more of the Champions' power quickly, for Iris...)

lines.speaker: 라현
lines.text: This is no time for that. The child Ouroboros has taken captive...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This is...)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Beyond time, into the world of the past... My beloved child of destiny...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ellie? Why is she saying that? Urgh... An unfamiliar pain washes over me... But why does her image overlap with Emperor Jiendia's? Why am I only sensing it now?)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You are...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The Ellie that Iris and I are watching suddenly seems to meet our eyes. No... Surely I'm imagining it?)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: You're looking at me now, Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (All of a sudden...)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Iris... A world without pain or sorrow has been created, just as you wished.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: You, whom Seres loves... This place, born from your will, is such a happy one.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: But Ouroboros awoke, having misunderstood your wish. He means to make it a world where nothing exists.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I knew, but...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It was because of me. I... I...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Iris, it isn't your fault. The fault lies with those who torment you.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Those who are now trying to devour your world...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Just as Odin and Nii have protected it from the past until now, you and %s can do it too, Iris.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: It is not your fault. You, who will become a great god...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ellie...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: %s, we'll meet someday. Until then, please help Iris first.
(With those words, the figures before you gradually fade away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, are you all right? It wasn't your fault.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: A being that awoke in the world I created... Ouroboros...
(Iris appears shaken.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Iris? Iris, are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Iris?
(Iris becomes utterly still, as though frozen in place. Then she suddenly disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris? Where did you go? Huh...? What's this feeling?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Everything before your eyes suddenly twists and warps. A black rift opens, beginning to swallow it all.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Th-this is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The sight of Ban disappearing in Moros suddenly flashes through your mind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: N-no! I have to get out of here!
